title: माध्यमिक विद्यालयको विज्ञान विषयमा, प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको शिक्षण एवं मूल्याङ्कन {Madhyamik bidyalayako bigyan bisayama, prayogatmak pakshako shikshan ebam mulyankan}
nepali: वैज्ञानिक ज्ञान तथा सीपको विकास गराउन प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको ठूलो महत्व हुन्छ । प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको शिक्षण एवं मूल्याङ्कन राम्रो हुन सकेन भने सैद्धान्तिक पक्षले मात्र विज्ञान अधुरो रहन्छ । विद्यार्थीहरुले विज्ञान विषयलाई एक कठीन विषयको रुपमा लिएका र एस. एल.सी परीक्षामा पनि राम्रो नतिजा आउन नसक्नुको मुख्य कारण प्रयोगात्मक पक्षलाई ध्यान नदिनु मान्न सकिन्छ । अतः माध्यमिक शिक्षाको विज्ञान विषयमा प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको शिक्षण एवं मूल्याङ्कन के कसरी भैरहेको छ र प्रयोगात्मक शिक्षणको लागि आवश्यक पर्ने शैक्षिक सामग्रीहरु के के हुन सक्छन् ? ती सामग्रीहरुको उपयोग के कसरी भएको छ ? प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको मूल्याङ्कन के कसरी गरिन्छ ? जस्ता प्रश्नको उत्तर खोज्ने प्रयाश यस अनुसन्धानले गरेको छ । अध्ययनको क्रममा कपिलवस्तु जिल्लाका ६ वटा सार्वजनिक विद्यालय र एउटा नीजि (संस्थागत) विद्यालय गरी जम्मा ७ वटा विद्यालयहरु छनौट गरी उक्त विद्यालयका प्र.अ.हरु, विज्ञान शिक्षकहरु र कक्षा १० मा अध्ययनरत छात्रछात्राहरु सँग अन्तरक्रिया, अन्तरवार्ता र छलफल गरी तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको थियो । अध्ययनबाट विज्ञान शिक्षाको प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको शिक्षण एवं मूल्याङ्कन तोके अनुसार नहुने गरेको पाइयो । विज्ञान शिक्षकहरुले, पाठ्यक्रम, प्रयोगात्मक पुस्तिका, विशिष्टिकरण तालिका         (प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा) को कम प्रयोग गरेको पाइयो । पाठ्यपुस्तकमा दिएका ‘गरी हेरी सिक्नुहोस्’ र अन्य क्रियाकलाप समेत अत्यन्त न्यून मात्रामा गर्न लगाउने गरेको पाइयो । सवैजसो विद्यालयमा विज्ञान प्रयोगशाला थप पुस्तकहरु र विज्ञान विषयलाई आवश्यक पर्ने शैक्षिक सामगीहरु समेत नभएको पाइयो । वहुसंख्यक विद्यालयमा भएका शैक्षिक सामाग्रीहरुको प्रयोग गर्ने नगरेको साथै स्थानीय रुपमा पाइने सामग्रीलाई शैक्षिक सामग्रीको रुपमा प्रयोग गर्ने पनि नगरेको देखियो । प्रयोगात्मक कार्यको लागि अलग समयको व्यवस्था नभएको पाइयो । प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको मूल्याङ्कन कुनै पनि विद्यालयमा विशिष्टीकरण तालिका (प्रयोगात्मक पक्ष) को आधारमा गर्ने गरेको देखिएन । जसबाट विद्यार्थीहरुमा विज्ञानको पढाइलाई केवल कण्ठस्थ पार्ने र परीक्षाको दृष्टिकोणले मात्र पढ्ने र विज्ञान विषयलाई व्यवहारिक रुपमा ल्याउन नसकेको अवस्था रहेको छ । प्रयोगको लागि चाहिने उपयुक्त समय विद्यालयको समय सारिणीमा छुट्याउनु पर्दछ । प्रयोगात्मकको शिक्षण पनि हुनुपर्दछ । प्रयोगशालाको व्यवस्थाका साथसाथै ल्याव ब्वाए को समेत व्यवस्था हुनु पर्दछ । माथिका समस्याहरुको समाधानको लागि विद्यालय, शिक्षक, अभिभावक, विद्यार्थी तथा सम्बन्धित निकायबाट उपयुक्त भूमिका निर्वाह गर्नु पर्ने हुन्छ । विज्ञान विषयको प्रयोगात्मक पक्षलाई वढी जोड दिन जिल्ला जिल्लामा विज्ञान प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा समति बनाउनु पर्दछ र सोही परीक्षा समितिले वाह्य परिक्षकको व्यवस्था गरी प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको मूल्याङ्कन गर्नु पर्दछ । विज्ञान शिक्षकलाई अन्य शिक्षकको तुलनामा कम पिरियडको व्यवस्था गर्नु पर्दछ सो कम पिरियडलाई विज्ञान शिक्षकले प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको तयारीमा लगाउनु पर्दछ । विज्ञान शिक्षकलाई शैक्षिक सामाग्रीहरुको निर्माणको लागि उचित तालिमको व्यवस्था हुनुपर्दछ । जिल्ला भरीको मात्र नभै क्षेत्रिय तथा राष्ट्रि«य स्तरमा एकै किसिमको प्रयोगात्मक पक्षको शिक्षण एवं मूल्याङ्कनका लागि क्षेत्रिय स्तरका विज्ञान शिक्षकहरुको गोष्ठी, सेमिनार गराउनु पर्दछ । साथै हरेक व्यक्तिले मूल्याङ्कन प्रणालीलाई सुधार गरी आफ्नो कर्तव्य प्रति सधै सजक रहनुपर्दछ । समय सापेक्ष विद्यालयको भौतिक अवस्था सुधार र पुन निर्माण गरी विज्ञान विषयको महत्वको पक्षमा विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समिति, प्र.अ.हरुलाई तालिम दिनु पर्दछ । त्यति गर्न सकेमा अवश्यपनि विज्ञान विषयको प्रयोगात्मक पक्ष वलियो भई विज्ञान शिक्षा राष्ट्र निर्माणलाई समेत टेवा पु¥याउन सक्नेछ ।
american_english:
The practical side is of great importance in developing scientific knowledge and skills.
If the teaching and evaluation of the practical side cannot be good, science remains incomplete with the theoretical side alone.
The main reason why students have taken the science subject as a difficult subject and good results cannot come even in the SLC examination can be considered to be the failure to pay attention to the practical side.
Therefore, this research has made an attempt to seek answers to questions such as: How is the teaching and evaluation of the practical side being carried out in the science subject of secondary education, and what can the educational materials needed for practical teaching be?
How have those materials been put to use?
How is the evaluation of the practical side done?
This research has made an attempt to find answers to such questions.
In the course of the study, a total of seven schools — six public schools and one private (institutional) school in Kapilvastu district — were selected, and data were collected by holding interactions, interviews and discussions with the principals, science teachers and boys and girls studying in class 10 of those schools.
From the study, it was found that the teaching and evaluation of the practical side of science education were not taking place as prescribed.
It was found that science teachers made little use of the curriculum, the practical workbook and the specification table (practical examination).
It was found that they had students do the 'Learn by Doing' activities given in the textbook and other activities to an extremely minimal extent.
In almost all schools, it was found that there was no science laboratory, no additional books, and not even the educational materials needed for the science subject.
It was seen that in the majority of schools they did not use the educational materials that were available, and they also did not use locally available materials as educational materials.
It was found that no separate time had been arranged for practical work.
The evaluation of the practical side was not seen to be done in any school on the basis of the specification table (practical side).
As a result of this, there is a situation in which students merely memorize the study of science and study only from the viewpoint of the examination, and science as a subject cannot be brought into practice.
The appropriate time needed for experiments should be set aside in the school timetable.
Teaching of the practical side should also take place.
Along with the arrangement of the laboratory, provision of a lab boy should also be made.
For the solution of the above problems, schools, teachers, parents, students and the concerned bodies must play an appropriate role.
In order to give more emphasis to the practical side of the science subject, science practical examination committees should be formed in each district, and the same examination committee should arrange for an external examiner and evaluate the practical side.
Fewer periods should be arranged for science teachers compared with other teachers, and the science teacher should devote those fewer periods to preparation for the practical side.
Proper training should be arranged for science teachers for the construction of educational materials.
Not only throughout the district but at the regional and national levels, meetings and seminars of regional-level science teachers should be held for the same kind of teaching and evaluation of the practical side.
In addition, every person should improve the evaluation system and remain always alert to their duty.
The physical condition of schools should be improved and reconstructed in keeping with time, and training should be given to school management committees and principals on the importance of the science subject.
If that can be done, then certainly the practical side of the science subject will become strong and science education will be able to lend support even to nation building.

australian_english:
The practical side matters a great deal when it comes to building scientific knowledge and skills.
If the teaching and assessment of the practical side aren't up to scratch, science stays half-finished with the theory side alone.
The main reason students see science as a hard subject and good results don't come through even in the SLC exam can be put down to not paying attention to the practical side.
So this research has had a go at finding answers to questions like: how is the teaching and assessment of the practical side going in the science subject at the secondary level, and what sorts of educational materials might be needed for practical teaching?
How have those materials been used?
How is the assessment of the practical side done?
This research has tried to find answers to questions like these.
In the course of the study, seven schools in all were picked in Kapilvastu district — six government schools and one private (institutional) school — and data were collected by talking with, interviewing and discussing things with the principals, science teachers and the boys and girls studying in class 10 at those schools.
From the study it came out that the teaching and assessment of the practical side of science education were not happening the way they're supposed to.
It came out that science teachers were making little use of the curriculum, the practical workbook and the specification table (practical exam).
It came out that they were getting students to do the 'Learn by Doing' activities in the textbook and other activities only to a very tiny extent.
In just about every school it came out that there was no science lab, no extra books and not even the educational materials the science subject needs.
In most schools it was clear that the educational materials they did have weren't being used, and locally available materials weren't being used as educational materials either.
It came out that no separate time had been set aside for practical work.
In no school was the assessment of the practical side seen to be done on the basis of the specification table (practical side).
Because of that, students are left just memorising their science study and studying only with the exam in mind, and the science subject can't be brought into practice.
The right time needed for experiments should be set aside in the school timetable.
Practical teaching should happen too.
Along with sorting out the lab, a lab boy should be arranged as well.
To sort out the problems above, schools, teachers, parents, students and the bodies concerned all need to play their part properly.
To put more weight on the practical side of the science subject, science practical exam committees should be set up in every district, and that same exam committee should arrange an external examiner and assess the practical side.
Science teachers should get fewer periods than other teachers, and the science teacher should put those fewer periods into getting ready for the practical side.
Proper training should be arranged for science teachers to make educational materials.
Not only across the district but at regional and national level too, meetings and seminars for regional-level science teachers should be held so that the teaching and assessment of the practical side are the same everywhere.
On top of that, everyone should improve the assessment system and stay on their toes about their duty.
Schools' physical condition should be improved and rebuilt to keep up with the times, and school management committees and principals should be trained on why the science subject matters.
If that can be done, the practical side of the science subject will surely get strong, and science education will be able to give nation building a hand as well.
